lines.zh: 我四条腿走着，背上多了东西。
lines.en: I walk on four legs, and something has grown on my back.
The saddle is still strapped on. The straps have rotted.
Step by step. My hooves are heavy.
The thing on my back moves.
It isn't heavy. But it's there.
I follow the road toward the village.
I remember this road.

lines.zh: 以前有人骑着我走这条路。
lines.en: Someone used to ride me along it.
Then he got down.
After that, it became like this.

lines.zh: 我打了个响鼻，声音不对。
lines.en: I snort, and the sound is wrong.
I keep to the road.
I sniff the grass at the roadside.
I don't want the grass by the road.
My forehoof hangs; I forget to set it down.

lines.zh: 走了很久，也没走出这块地。
lines.en: I've walked a long time and haven't left this field.
I stand with my tail hanging.
The thing on my back is breathing.
It doesn't keep my rhythm.
I shake and it doesn't come off.
I look down at my own legs.
One is thicker than the rest.
I lift it and move it.
It moves on its own too.
I stop and it stops.
I listen. There's a sound behind me.
The name on the saddle isn't mine.
The girth is loose; I shake myself.
The sound behind me follows.
I don't look back at it.
Looking back wouldn't help.
So I just stand here.
You smell of horses.
Have you ridden one?
I remember someone riding me.
His hands on the reins were steady.
I can't make out his face now.
Don't get on my back.
There's no room up there anymore.

lines.zh: 你离远些，我背上那个醒着。
lines.en: Stay back; the thing on my back is awake.
You're holding reins.
Drop the reins.
I don't answer to reins now.

lines.zh: 我朝你挪，鞍子吱了一声。
lines.en: I shift toward you; the saddle creaks.
I cry out. It isn't a horse's sound.

lines.zh: 我的蹄铁刮过石头，火星溅开。
lines.en: My shoe scrapes stone and throws sparks.
The thing on my back shrinks in.
It can be afraid too.
That makes me feel a little better.
The thing on my back breathes for me.
I shake my head and shed the reins.
I stand firm on four hooves.

lines.zh: 我被同化后，还认得马鞍。
lines.en: Assimilated, I still know a saddle.
That's enough to put me down a while.
Is that an apple in your hand?
I remember what apples taste like.
You reach out and I lower my head.
My mouth isn't the right shape now.
I try. I can't hold it.
It falls to the ground.
I lower my head to look.
I can smell it. I can't eat it.
I stand there a while.
I turn, reins dragging in the grass.
Keep the apple; I can't bite.
Give it to another horse.

lines.zh: 我低下头，用鼻子拱了拱。
lines.en: I lower my head and nudge it with my nose.

lines.zh: 这东西，以前我一口气能吃三个。
lines.en: I used to eat three of these at once.
Now I can't even chew one.
I lift my head, then lower it again.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧面，退了两步。
lines.en: You hit my flank and go back two steps.
Sticky threads reach for you from under my saddle.
It reaches a little toward you.
I stepped back half a pace and turned again.

lines.zh: 这一下，你手上全是黏液。
lines.en: Now your hands are covered in slime.
It won't wash off for a few days.
An assimilated horse turns slowly.
Standing between you and the road.
Stand where you are. Don't move.
And I won't move a step.
There are still horses at the stable.
They back away when they see me.
They can smell it.
One of them didn't.
It came a little closer, then left.
I stood where I was.
I knew I should walk away.
So I walked away.
I didn't go into the stable.
I stood outside all night.
I lower my head and take the grass.
Two chews and it won't go down.

lines.zh: 我嘴里的草渣混血落在地上。
lines.en: Cud and blood fall from my mouth.
There's a bucket on the ground.
I put my mouth in it.
The water in the bucket is cloudy.
I drink two mouthfuls.
The taste is wrong, and I'm thirsty.
I knock the bucket over.
The water runs across the ground.
Someone's standing by the road.
An assimilated horse has no reins left.
The thing on my back raises too.
The thing on my back is watching.
I'm not.
I lower my head and walk on.
It tugs at me.
The thing on my back pulls me short.
We stand in the middle of the road.
The person stops too.
I follow him a way.
Not fast. Just following.
He looks back and I stop.
He turns away and I walk again.
We go on like this a long while.
He's started to run.

lines.zh: 我的四条腿已经变了形。
lines.en: My four legs have warped out of shape.

lines.zh: 跑起来，四条腿各走各的。
lines.en: Running, my four legs go their own ways.
I can't catch him.
I stop, breathing hard.
I rear and bring my forehooves down.
It comes down on nothing.
I turn and kick with my hind legs.
My hind hooves connect.

lines.zh: 背上的东西也伸了出来。
lines.en: The thing on my back reached out too.

lines.zh: 我的腿，被同化得变了形。
lines.en: Assimilation warped my legs.
I push back on all four hooves.
It gets dragged back a little.
We're both breathing hard.

lines.zh: 我的后蹄再蹬，踢中你的膝。
lines.en: My hind hooves kick into your knee.

lines.zh: 我从马厩后面的黑草里站起来。
lines.en: I rise from the black grass behind the stable.
The saddle is still on my back.
Half a rope hangs from the peg.

lines.zh: 我的蹄子落地，声音是空的。
lines.en: My hooves land hollow.
I push up onto four legs.
There's no sound from the stable.
There used to be sound in there.
I go over and look in.
The stable is empty.
Hay on the floor, and hoofprints.
Fire catches my mane and I bolt.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，鞍摔裂了。
lines.en: I roll down the slope and the saddle splits.

lines.zh: 水没过我的鼻孔，我挣不上来。
lines.en: Water covers my nostrils and I can't rise.

lines.zh: 炸响把马厩掀了，我被压在下面。
lines.en: The blast wrecks the stable and I'm pinned under it.

lines.zh: 我的皮已经被同化透了。
lines.en: Assimilation has gone right through my hide.

lines.zh: 一道光缠住我，我动不了。
lines.en: A light coils around me and I can't move.

lines.zh: 草咽不下去，我一直空着。
lines.en: I can't swallow grass. I've been empty.

lines.zh: 雷打在马厩上，我整身都麻了。
lines.en: Lightning hits the stable and numbs me through.

lines.zh: 没有地，四条腿在空里刨。
lines.en: No ground. Four legs paw at nothing.
